requirements.quote:
Upon receipt by a client, it will be identified as a Version
   Negotiation packet based on the Version field having a value of 0.
requirements.condition: A client receives a packet whose Version field is 0.
requirements.required_behavior: Identify the packet as a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet parser can be tested to verify that a zero Version field selects the Version Negotiation packet type.

requirements.quote:
The Version Negotiation packet is a response to a client packet that
   contains a version that is not supported by the server.  It is only
   sent by servers.
requirements.condition: A Version Negotiation packet is sent.
requirements.required_behavior: It is sent by a server in response to a client packet containing a version that the server does not support.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Clients or other non-server endpoints must not send Version Negotiation packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Endpoint role, triggering packet, and supported-version state can be observed in implementation tests.

requirements.quote:
Version Negotiation Packet {
     Header Form (1) = 1,
     Unused (7),
     Version (32) = 0,
     Destination Connection ID Length (8),
     Destination Connection ID (0..2040),
     Source Connection ID Length (8),
     Source Connection ID (0..2040),
     Supported Version (32) ...,
   }
requirements.condition: Encoding or parsing a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the Header Form as a 1-bit field with value 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The first header bit can be inspected directly in a serialized packet.

requirements.quote:
The value in the Unused field is set to an arbitrary value by the
   server.  Clients MUST ignore the value of this field.  Where QUIC
requirements.condition: A server sends a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the Unused field to an arbitrary value.
requirements.why_checkable: Generated packets can be inspected to ensure the field is populated without imposing a fixed semantic value.

requirements.quote:
The value in the Unused field is set to an arbitrary value by the
   server.  Clients MUST ignore the value of this field.  Where QUIC
requirements.condition: A client processes a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Ignore the value of the Unused field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not make packet-processing behavior depend on the Unused field's value.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary all Unused-field values and verify unchanged client processing.

requirements.quote:
The Version field of a Version Negotiation packet MUST be set to
   0x00000000.
requirements.condition: A Version Negotiation packet is constructed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a nonzero Version field.
requirements.why_checkable: The 32-bit Version field can be inspected directly in packet bytes.

requirements.quote:
The server MUST include the value from the Source Connection ID field
   of the packet it receives in the Destination Connection ID field.
requirements.condition: A server constructs a Version Negotiation packet in response to a received packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Copy the received packet's Source Connection ID value into the Version Negotiation packet's Destination Connection ID field.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the triggering packet's Source Connection ID with the response's Destination Connection ID.

requirements.quote:

requirements.condition: A server constructs a Version Negotiation packet in response to a received packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Copy the received packet's Destination Connection ID value into the Version Negotiation packet's Source Connection ID field.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the triggering packet's Destination Connection ID with the response's Source Connection ID.

requirements.quote:
specific rules for the connection ID therefore MUST NOT influence a
   decision about whether to send a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.condition: An implementation decides whether to send a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not allow version-specific connection ID rules to influence the send decision.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary whether connection IDs satisfy version-specific rules while holding the unsupported-version trigger constant and compare the send decision.

requirements.quote:
The remainder of the Version Negotiation packet is a list of 32-bit
   versions that the server supports.
requirements.condition: A server encodes the remainder of a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a list of 32-bit version values supported by that server.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not list versions that the server does not support.
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized entries can be parsed as 32-bit values and compared with the server's configured supported-version set.

requirements.quote:
A Version Negotiation packet is not acknowledged.  It is only sent in
   response to a packet that indicates an unsupported version; see
   Section 5.2.2.
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not acknowledge the Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime trace can verify that receipt does not cause an acknowledgment.

requirements.quote:
A Version Negotiation packet is not acknowledged.  It is only sent in
   response to a packet that indicates an unsupported version; see
   Section 5.2.2.
requirements.condition: A server sends a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Send it only in response to a packet indicating an unsupported version.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send it without such a triggering packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet traces and the server's supported-version set can establish whether every response had the required trigger.

requirements.quote:
The Version Negotiation packet does not include the Packet Number and
   Length fields present in other packets that use the long header form.
requirements.condition: Encoding a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include Packet Number or Length fields.
requirements.why_checkable: A serialized packet can be parsed to verify the absence of both fields.

requirements.quote:
Consequently, a Version Negotiation packet consumes an entire UDP
   datagram.
requirements.condition: A UDP datagram carries a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The Version Negotiation packet occupies the entire UDP datagram.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not place additional packet data after the Version Negotiation packet in the same UDP datagram.
requirements.why_checkable: Datagram boundaries and decoded packet extent can be compared directly.

requirements.quote:
A server MUST NOT send more than one Version Negotiation packet in
   response to a single UDP datagram.
requirements.condition: A server responds to a single UDP datagram.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send more than one Version Negotiation packet in response to that datagram.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can count Version Negotiation response packets per triggering UDP datagram.
